name: 登録済み方法と新規追加を並べる請求設定パネル
prompt:
Create a faithful Japanese-localized two-column payment settings panel based on the supplied references. The original screenshot is primary for column geometry and detailed control placement; the Japanese preview is primary for exact wording, the hidden saved-card suffix, selected state, and success message. Render only this panel on a clean white canvas at roughly 1137×472 proportions (about 2.41:1), with the saved method on the left and the new-method form on the right. Include the visible success state as shown; do not depict any payment-processing behavior beyond that static message.

Left column: heading 「登録済み」. Show one saved method with 「カード・末尾は非表示」, then 「カード」 and 「12月・2027年」. Keep the suffix hidden; do not infer or invent digits. Align a quiet 「初期設定」 pill and a compact outlined delete button with a trash icon at the right side of the saved row. Below, show the muted note 「今後の支払いには、この方法が使用されます。」.

Right column: heading 「新しく追加」. Show two payment choice cards side by side, with 「カード」 selected in pale green with a green outline and 「米国の銀行口座」 unselected in gray. Below, add 「カード番号」 with the supplied sample placeholder 「1234 1234 1234 1234」; then two side-by-side fields 「有効期限」 / 「月 / 年」 and 「確認番号」 / 「3桁」. Treat the number as a sample placeholder only and do not add any real card data or security code. Add the full-width green button 「支払い方法を追加」 and directly beneath it the green success message 「支払い方法を正常に追加しました。」.

Use compact, clearly separated columns, subtle neutral borders, restrained Japanese sans-serif typography, and consistent input spacing. Match the references' proportions and avoid broad blank bands. Do not add logos, extra fields, or any wording beyond the specified Japanese text.
reviewNotes: Registered v001 with stored:true and catalogUpdated:true. Candidate 1946x808 (2.408:1) matches source crop proportions and includes the saved-method column, add form, static success text, and mock wording. Masked suffix remains hidden and the new number is only a reference placeholder. The option-card icons are inline instead of stacked above their labels in both references; marked needs-correction. SHA-256 matches manifest/catalog; metadata prompt/references, HTML entry, and stored image were verified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
